content: Hello, I am Meridian Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Lane Birch?
Yes, this is Lane Birch speaking.
First, I need to confirm your identity. What is your postcode?
Thank you. What is your year of birth?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount today?
I can't pay the full 900, I'm afraid. I do have money in the account, but most of it is already set aside for household bills, and only 200 is available for this.
I cannot record 200.00. The minimum is 300.00. Could you pay 300.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026? The remaining balance stays overdue.
No, I'm sorry, I can't commit to 300. Two hundred is all I have for this, and I'm not going to take it from the household money.
Could you pay 900.00 for the credit card on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, a different date doesn't change anything. I can't pay 900 tomorrow either; 200 is the most I can put towards this card.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
